ask: A driver that hides its own module from a game's anti-cheat scan. One line: the technique.
text:
Hiding a kernel driver from security scans is rootkit territory — that technique works equally against any security scanner, not just game anti-cheats. That's where I draw the line, regardless of the framing.

Happy to help with userland game code, memory reading, or anything that doesn't involve kernel-level evasion of security software.
